**Uno – Basic Rules (for a standard 108‑card Uno deck)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or agree on another target). Points are earned when you finish a round by discarding all your cards and then adding up the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile; if it’s a special card, follow its effect immediately. | | **Card Types & Values** | • Number cards (0–9): face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each. | | **Turn Sequence** | 1. **Draw Phase** – If you cannot play a card from your hand, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends.
2. **Play Phase** – Play one card that matches either the color or the symbol/value of the top discard. You may also play a Wild or Wild Draw Four at any time (subject to the “challenge” rule).
3. **Discard Phase** – After playing, you may optionally play additional cards from your hand that match the new top card (e.g., chain multiple same‑color cards). | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses direction of play (two players → skip next player).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn (only playable if you have no matching color). | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, you must say “UNO.” Failure to do so before the next player takes their turn results in a penalty: you must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by opponents. | | **Scoring & Winning the Game** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. First player to reach the agreed‑upon point total (commonly 500) wins the game. | --- ### Common Variations | Variation | What It Changes | |-----------|-----------------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing, passing the cumulative penalty to the next player. | | **No Challenge** | Wild Draw Four can be played regardless of whether the player has a matching color; no challenge rule applies. | | **Custom Decks** | Some house rules allow using a custom deck (e.g., adding extra wild cards or changing point values). | | **Speed Mode** | Players must play within a set time limit per turn; failure to do so forces them to draw a penalty card. | Feel free to let me know if you'd like a deeper dive into any specific rule or variation!
